detector_config.envelope_source: GOST 23961-80 figures 6 and 7, https://engenegr.ru/gost-23961-80. Upper contour exact piecewise segments; lower contour horizontally filled conservatively, omitting wheel recesses. Mirrors and contact-collector extensions excluded. No actual vehicle/curve dynamic validation.
detector_config.deskew_policy: Disabled until acquisition span versus scan period and prior deskew provenance are verified. KISS-ICP normalizes the supplied point-time range to one full previous motion increment.

installation_reference.statement: Лидар (нулевая точка его отсчёта) стоит на уровне 1075мм от уровня головки рельсов, ровно посередине между ними. На пустом вагоне без движения.
installation_reference.height_direction_definition: reported above railheads; gravity vertical versus track-plane normal unspecified

limitations: Records are unchanged complete JSONL rows, selected by exact integer acquisition timestamps.
Only the first frame of each requested episode is included, not its complete temporal history.
No per-point component support was stored in this full run. Bounding boxes, counts and raw-cloud crops are not a substitute for cluster membership.
Geometry contains fitted rail anchors and path state; these are detector estimates, not independent track ground truth.
